articles.title: Russian bombing kills 24 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
articles.description: Local officials say 27 people had been missing after at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a village in southern Ukraine.
articles.titleJa: ロシアの爆撃によりウクライナの援助センターで24人死亡、キーウ発表
articles.summary: ロシア軍によるウクライナ南部の村への爆撃で、援助センターが攻撃され24人が死亡。さらに27人が行方不明となっている。

articles.title: Fake nuclear warning from hacked app sparks unease but not panic in Ukraine
articles.description: Many Ukrainians, who have faced years of Russian attacks, did not take the messages seriously and doubted their veracity.
articles.titleJa: ハッキングされたアプリからの偽の核警報、ウクライナで不安を引き起こすもパニックにはならず
articles.summary: ハッキングされたアプリから偽の核警報が発令されたが、長年のロシアの攻撃に慣れた多くのウクライナ人はこれを深刻に受け止めず、パニックは生じなかった。

articles.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
articles.description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.
articles.titleJa: 欧州7カ国の店舗冷凍庫がサイバー攻撃を受ける
articles.summary: 欧州7カ国の複数の店舗で冷凍庫がサイバー攻撃を受け、内部温度が最大50℃まで上昇したと報じられている。経済的影響が懸念される。

articles.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
articles.description: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.
articles.titleJa: ウクライナ戦争最長の停戦後、ヘルソン地域で戦闘が再開
articles.summary: ウクライナ戦争で最長となる6日間の停戦期間が終了し、ヘルソン地域で再び戦闘が勃発。停戦は戦争の全体的な流れを変えるには至らなかった。

articles.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
articles.description: Jos Leijdekkers has been found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be in Sierra Leone.
articles.titleJa: オランダ警察、麻薬王捜索に過去最高の200万ユーロの報奨金を提供
articles.summary: オランダ警察は、コカイン密輸で有罪判決を受けシエラレオネに潜伏中とされる麻薬王ヨス・レイデッカーズの捜索に、過去最高の200万ユーロの報奨金を設定した。

articles.title: Five arrested after South African farmer shot and tortured
articles.description: The attack on Donovan Marx, 50, comes as right-wing groups say there is a genocide of white people - a claim widely discredited.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカで農家が銃撃・拷問された事件で5人逮捕
articles.summary: 南アフリカで農家のドノバン・マルクス氏（50歳）が銃撃され拷問を受けた事件で5人が逮捕された。右翼団体が主張する「白人虐殺」の文脈で報じられているが、この主張は広く否定されている。

articles.title: Wizz Air flight from Luton in emergency landing after bomb threat
articles.description: A Hungarian fighter jet escorted the aircraft to Budapest after the threat was received mid-air.
articles.titleJa: 爆破予告を受け、ルートン発のウィズエア便が緊急着陸
articles.summary: 爆破予告を受けたルートン発のウィズエア便が、ハンガリーの戦闘機の護衛のもとブダペストに緊急着陸した。乗客の安全は確保された。

articles.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
articles.description: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.
articles.titleJa: ライアンエアー、従業員の賃金凍結と運賃値上げの可能性を示唆
articles.summary: ライアンエアーは、米・イスラエルとイランの紛争が終結しない場合、2028年までに燃料費が20億ユーロ増加する可能性があり、従業員の賃金凍結や運賃値上げを検討すると発表した。

articles.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
articles.description: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.
articles.titleJa: 史上最大の仮想通貨ハッキングを受け、バイナンスのユーザーが36億ドルを引き出し
articles.summary: 史上最大の仮想通貨ハッキング事件が発生し、これを受けバイナンスのユーザーは36億ドルを引き出した。この事件は北朝鮮のグループに関連付けられている。

articles.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years
articles.description: Uganda has been helping Somalia battle an insurgency led by the al-Shabab militant group since 2007.
articles.titleJa: ウガンダ、20年ぶりにソマリアからの軍撤退を開始
articles.summary: ウガンダは2007年以来、ソマリアでアル・シャバブとの反乱鎮圧を支援してきたが、20年の任務を終え、部隊の撤退を開始した。地域の安定に影響を与える可能性もある。

articles.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to block 20,000 California midterm ballots
articles.description: The Trump administration has appealed to the Supreme Court over claims that a list of more than 20,000 ballots in California include non-US citizens. Multiple courts and independent analysis have rejected the claims.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏、最高裁にカリフォルニア州中間選挙の2万票阻止を要請
articles.summary: トランプ政権は、カリフォルニア州の中間選挙で2万票以上に非米国市民が含まれるとの主張で最高裁に提訴。複数の裁判所と独立分析は、この主張を却下している。

articles.title: France: Petition to ban TV channel gets 500,000 signatures
articles.description: Support for the petition has surged since last month's shooting of a Black man by a reported avid viewer of CNews. Critics say the channel, often compared to Fox News, is a platform for anti-immigrant sentiments.
articles.titleJa: フランス：テレビ局の放送禁止を求める嘆願書が50万人の署名を集める
articles.summary: フランスで、CNewsの放送禁止を求める嘆願書が50万人の署名を集めた。視聴者による黒人男性銃撃事件以来、支持が急増。批評家は、同局が反移民感情の温床だと批判する。

articles.title: What might Trump have planned for Iran following the midterm election?
articles.description: While the US midterms could open a window for diplomacy with Iran, they could also unleash a new military escalation. DW spoke with analysts to identify eight factors that could tip the balance toward war or peace.
articles.titleJa: 中間選挙後、トランプ氏のイランに対する計画は？
articles.summary: 米中間選挙はイランとの外交の機会を開く可能性も、新たな軍事衝突を引き起こす可能性もある。アナリストは、戦争か平和に傾く可能性のある8つの要因を指摘する。

articles.title: Ice hockey officials considering options after CAS order to reinstate Russia
articles.description: Ice hockey's ruling body is deciding how to respond to a decision by the Court of Arbitration for Sport that allows Russia back into international competition. Germany hasn't ruled out pulling out as a tournament host.
articles.titleJa: CASのロシア復帰命令を受け、アイスホッケー連盟が対応を検討
articles.summary: スポーツ仲裁裁判所がロシアの国際大会復帰を命じたことを受け、アイスホッケー統括団体が対応策を検討中。ドイツはトーナメント開催国からの撤退も否定していない。

articles.title: European supermarkets targeted in second reported cyberattack
articles.description: Supermarkets across Europe have been targeted in cyberattacks once again. Three weeks after a defrosting attack in France, supermarkets in Belgium, Estonia, Ireland, Luxembourg and Sweden reported freezer malfunctions.
articles.titleJa: 欧州のスーパーマーケットで2度目のサイバー攻撃が報告される
articles.summary: 欧州各地のスーパーマーケットが再びサイバー攻撃の標的に。フランスでの凍結解除攻撃から3週間後、ベルギー、エストニア、アイルランドなどで冷凍庫の誤作動が報告された。

articles.title: LA communities kick out Big Oil
articles.description: After years of advocacy from residents and legal battles with Big Oil, Los Angeles voted to ban drilling and phase out oil extraction in the city. It's the first city in the United States to kick the oil industry out.
articles.titleJa: ロサンゼルス市、石油産業を追放
articles.summary: 長年の住民運動と法廷闘争を経て、ロサンゼルス市は市内の石油掘削を禁止し、石油採掘を段階的に廃止することを決定。米国の都市で初めて石油産業を締め出した。

articles.title: Germany's chancellor called for Korean unity. Does Seoul want that?
articles.description: Germany, like Korea, was once divided by rival political systems and by one of the world's most fortified borders. Chancellor Merz called for a reunified Korea during his recent visit — but the prospect seems faint.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ首相が朝鮮半島の統一を呼びかけ。ソウルはその実現を望むか？
articles.summary: ドイツの首相が訪問中に朝鮮半島の統一を呼びかけた。かつて分断されたドイツと同様に、韓国も統一問題に直面するが、その見通しは依然として不透明だ。

articles.title: Global pedestrian Karl Bushby returns home to UK after 28-year trek
articles.description: Karl Bushby, a British man who traveled 50,000 km without transport over the past 28 years, has come home. Starting in Chile, he crossed the Americas, Russia and parts of Central Asia and Europe — almost all on foot.
articles.titleJa: 28年間の徒歩世界一周を終え、英国人冒険家カール・ブッシュビー氏が帰国
articles.summary: 英国人カール・ブッシュビー氏が28年間かけて5万キロを徒歩で旅し、故郷英国に帰還。チリから出発し、アメリカ大陸、ロシア、中央アジア、ヨーロッパを横断した。

articles.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after two decades
articles.description: Ugandan troops first deployed to Somalia in 2007 as part of an international military coalition to battle Islamic insurgents. But the mission has faced mounting pressure since a US decision to withdraw funding.
articles.titleJa: ウガンダ、20年ぶりにソマリアからの部隊撤退を開始
articles.summary: ウガンダがソマリアからの部隊撤退を開始。2007年からイスラム過激派との戦いに参加していたが、米国の資金提供停止決定以降、ミッションへの圧力が強まっていた。

articles.title: How Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria
articles.description: Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria, promising to be a "president of peace." But the campaign showed how divided Bulgarians are about the war in Ukraine and drone attacks in the Black Sea.
articles.titleJa: イリアナ・ヨトバ氏がブルガリア大統領選で勝利した経緯
articles.summary: イリアナ・ヨトバ氏がブルガリア大統領選挙で勝利し、「平和の大統領」を公約。選挙戦は、国民がウクライナ戦争や黒海でのドローン攻撃についていかに意見が分かれているかを示した。

articles.title: Sinkholes, scarred land and scapegoats: the scourge of illegal gold mining in Johannesburg
articles.description:
There is no end in sight for the drivers of illegal mining, while police action appears ineffective
Cora Bailey has been encountering illegal miners ever since she first started treating injured animals in the townships around Roodepoort, west of Johannesburg, in 1991. But as the price of gold has soared, so too has activity in the abandoned mine shafts that mark the area.
In late September, dozens of zama zamas – the name given to illegal miners in South Africa, meaning roughly “to take a chance” in Zulu – arrived to dig for gold across the dirt road from her charity, Claw (Community Led Animal Welfare).
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ヨハネスブルグにおける違法金採掘の災禍：陥没穴、荒廃した土地、スケープゴート
articles.summary: ヨハネスブルグ西部で違法金採掘が横行し、陥没穴や土地の荒廃を引き起こしている。警察の対策は効果がなく、金価格の高騰が問題に拍車をかけている。

articles.title: Sudanese diaspora and human rights groups denounce UAE nominee for UN top job
articles.description:
Critics cite Lana Nusseibeh’s denial of accusations the UAE is fuelling Sudan war by supporting paramilitary RSF
Members of the Sudanese diaspora and international human rights monitors have denounced the candidature of an Emirati diplomat for the top job at the UN, citing her denial of accusations that the United Arab Emirates is fuelling the war in Sudan by supporting the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.
The UAE nominated Lana Nusseibeh last week to replace the UN secretary general, António Guterres, as he finishes his second five-year term ⁠this year, upending a race that had become gridlocked.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: スーダン人ディアスポラと人権団体がUAEの国連事務総長候補を非難
articles.summary: スーダン人ディアスポラと国際人権団体が、UAEの国連事務総長候補を非難。彼女がUAEによるスーダン紛争への支援疑惑を否定していることが理由で、国際的な対立が浮上している。

articles.title: Egypt fines prominent editor Lina Attalah and shuts independent news outlet Mada Masr
articles.description:
Warnings of escalating clampdown on press freedom come after Cairo court convicts Attalah of managing an unlicensed website
Lina Attalah, a prominent Egyptian journalist and the editor-in-chief of the news outlet Mada Masr, has been released from detention by Egypt’s authorities and had her website ordered to be shut down by a court amid an intensifying crackdown on independent media in the country.
Attalah was taken briefly into custody after a Cairo court convicted her of managing an unlicensed website, prompting fresh international concerns over press freedom in Egypt.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エジプト、著名な編集者リナ・アタラ氏に罰金を科し、独立系ニュースサイトMada Masrを閉鎖
articles.summary: エジプト当局は著名なジャーナリスト、リナ・アタラ氏を拘束し、裁判所は彼女のサイト閉鎖を命じた。同国の報道の自由に対する抑圧強化に国際的な懸念が高まっている。

articles.title: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official
articles.description:
Jean Kaseya, of the Africa CDC, warns of the illness spreading like Covid unless more funding is secured to increase preparedness and possible treatment
The “unprecedented” spread of the Ebola outbreak means it could reach the UK and other countries, according to one of Africa’s top health officials.
As the current outbreak reached 10,000 cases, with almost 5,000 deaths, Dr Jean Kaseya, director general of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), compared the outbreak to the Covid pandemic, which first took hold in China before spreading to countries across the world, claiming millions of lives, and ravaging health systems and economies.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アフリカの「前例のない」エボラ出血熱流行が英国に到達する可能性、トップ保健当局者が警告
articles.summary: アフリカ疾病対策予防センターは、エボラ出血熱の「前例のない」拡大により、英国を含む他国へ到達する可能性を警告した。パンデミック回避には資金と対策が必要。

articles.title: UK sanctions Sudanese military leaders implicated in El Fasher ‘campaign of rape’
articles.description:
Commanders suspected of sexual violence during the largest and fastest slaughter of civilians in more than 30 years have been subjected to travel ban and asset freeze
Senior Sudanese commanders implicated in a “campaign of rape” have been targeted by the UK on the first anniversary of a mass atrocity that saw tens of thousands of civilians killed over several days.
A year after the fall of El Fasher, the British government said it had sanctioned military leaders from both sides in the country’s ongoing conflict whom it suspected of sexual violence during the siege of the city.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 英国、エルファシールでの「レイプ運動」に関与したスーダン軍指導者らを制裁
articles.summary: 英国政府は、エルファシールでの市民虐殺と「レイプ運動」に関与した疑いのあるスーダン軍指導者らに対し、渡航禁止と資産凍結の制裁を科した。人権侵害への対応を強化している。

articles.title: UK was ‘vehement’ slavery reparations should not be on Commonwealth summit agenda
articles.description:
British prime minister has now agreed to structured dialogue on reparatory justice but issue remains off formal Chogm agenda 
British officials reportedly insisted that discussions of reparations for slavery should not be on the agenda of the Commonwealth leaders’ summit in Antigua and Barbuda – and even warned that Andy Burnham would not attend the meeting if the subject was formally included, according to a leading Caribbean political figure.
Ralph Gonsalves, a former prime minister of St Vincent and the Grenadines and a senior figure in the reparatory justice movement Repair Campaign, welcomed Britain’s decision to enter structured dialogue on reparations, but said the UK had come “kicking and screaming” to the conversation.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 英国、コモンウェルス首脳会議での奴隷制賠償議論に「猛反対」したと報道
articles.summary: 英国がコモンウェルス首脳会議で奴隷制賠償の議題化に強く反対していたと報じられた。最終的に構造化された対話には合意したが、正式な議題からは外れた。

articles.title: Canada and EU announce new alliance open to like-minded countries
articles.description:
Alliance for the Future, unveiled at Montreal summit and open to other countries, conceived for world ‘shaken by new storms’
Canada and Europe have announced a new alliance of like-minded nations to serve as both a “protective canopy under which our citizens can thrive” and a powerful hedge against the unpredictable nature of geopolitics, while welcoming other countries to join.
Speaking to reporters on Friday from Montreal, the prime minister, Mark Carney, and the European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, called the new partnership the Alliance for the Future and said the “deepest possible partnership between Canada and the 27-member bloc had the potential to offer unprecedented stability and opportunity”.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダとEU、志を同じくする国々に開かれた新たな同盟を発表
articles.summary: カナダとEUはモントリオール・サミットで「未来のための同盟」を発足させた。不安定な地政学的状況に対抗し、市民の繁栄を保護するためのもので、他国への参加も歓迎する。

articles.title: ‘Amateur morons’: Flávio Bolsonaro’s short-lived ‘president-elect’ claim met with mockery
articles.description:
Brazilian media ridicule defeated candidate over ‘shameful’ absconsion to US and bizarre letter with wrong coat of arms
Flávio Bolsonaro had hoped that by Sunday night people would be calling him the next president of Brazil.
Instead, the far-right politician’s decision to flee to the US after losing the election and – for 58 minutes – to declare himself “Brazil’s true president-elect”, has made him a laughing stock, with Brazilian newspapers and commentators raining a barrage of scornful adjectives down on the conquered candidate.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「アマチュアの愚か者」：フラビオ・ボルソナロの短命な「次期大統領」宣言が嘲笑を呼ぶ
articles.summary: ブラジルのメディアは、選挙に敗れたフラビオ・ボルソナロ氏が米国に逃亡し、一時的に「ブラジルの真の次期大統領」と宣言したことを「恥ずべき行為」として嘲笑している。

articles.title: Severe rainfall and flood warnings issued for central Greece and western Turkey
articles.description:
Turkey has been hit by powerful thunderstorms and a fatal tornado this week with more heavy rain expected
Heavy rain and strong winds will continue to affect parts of south-eastern Europe and Turkey over the next few days, as an area of low pressure in the region has allowed for the formation of powerful thunderstorms. During a particularly intense thunderstorm in Antalya, a coastal city in the south-west of Turkey, the formation of a tornado resulted in the deaths of four construction workers on Tuesday. Authorities in Greece and Turkey have released severe rainfall and flooding warnings, as a further 100-150mm (nearly 4-6in) of rain is expected this week in central Greece and western parts of Turkey, with locally higher totals possible.
Travelling eastwards towards south Asia, strong winds and heavy rainfall have swept across the Indian regions of Odisha and Andhra Pradesh as Cyclone Arnab made landfall. With wind gusts in excess of 85mph (140km/h) and rainfall totals in some regions exceeding 200mm, the severe storm has prompted mass evacuations of more than 180,000 people, as well as widespread disruption to energy and transport infrastructure. The cyclone will weaken as it continues to traverse northwards over the coming days, though will continue to deliver heavy rain to parts of northern and central India as it does so.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ギリシャ中部とトルコ西部で豪雨と洪水警報が発令
articles.summary: ギリシャ中部とトルコ西部で豪雨と洪水警報が発令された。トルコでは致命的な竜巻も発生し、建設作業員4人が死亡。さらに多くの降雨が予想され、地域全体で強い嵐と洪水のリスクが高まっている。

articles.title: Cuts like a knife: Canadian rocker Bryan Adams trolls Trump with new song
articles.description:
Musician wrote a ‘love letter’ to Canada with a new album – and some pointed commentary about the US president
Lake Ontario, the vast body of water that straddles the US-Canada border, has gone by many names over the centuries: Lac Saint-Louis, Lacus Ontarius, Skaniadorio, Cataraqui Lake. But one thing it will never be called, says the Canadian rock star Bryan Adams, is Lake America.
In his new song Lake Ontario, Adams takes aim at the US president, Donald Trump, accusing him of “breaking the peace” between the people who live on the lake’s shores.
The ‘lake of shining waters’ is what the Iroquois called her
It’s a First Nations name – not an executive order.
But things weren’t going his way in Iran
So like a baby tossing the toys from the pram
You can push us to the brink
But where the open road divides
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「ナイフのように切れる」：カナダのロッカー、ブライアン・アダムスが新曲でトランプをからかう
articles.summary: カナダのロックスター、ブライアン・アダムスが新曲「オンタリオ湖」でドナルド・トランプ米大統領を風刺し、話題となっている。彼はカナダへの「ラブレター」となるアルバムで政治的批判を展開した。

articles.title: Britain’s 'oldest cars' hit the road for annual London to Brighton run
articles.description: The UK celebrates 140 years of the motor car as pre-1905 vehicles parade through London's historic streets before heading to Brighton.
articles.titleJa: 英国の「最古の車」が恒例のロンドン-ブライトン走破に出発
articles.summary: 英国で、1905年以前の車両がロンドンからブライトンまで走る恒例イベントが開催され、自動車誕生140周年を祝いました。

articles.title: Hopes of 'progress toward peace' knocked by deadly Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, Zelenskyy says
articles.description: Zelenskyy said the Zaporizhzhia attack showed Russia was "sending an entirely opposite signal" and that it was "counting on more killings."
articles.titleJa: ゼレンスキー大統領、ザポリージャへのロシアの攻撃で「和平への進展」の希望が打ち砕かれたと語る
articles.summary: ロシアのザポリージャ攻撃により、和平への希望が打ち砕かれたとゼレンスキー大統領が発言。ロシアがさらなる殺害を狙っていると非難しました。

articles.title: Recent virus outbreaks show urgent need to complete pandemic treaty, says WHO chief
articles.description: The WHO chief said recent outbreaks of Ebola and hantavirus show why countries must finalise the agreement without delay.
articles.titleJa: WHO事務局長、最近のウイルス発生がパンデミック条約の締結の緊急性を浮き彫りにしたと発言
articles.summary: WHO事務局長は、最近のエボラ出血熱やハンタウイルスの発生が、パンデミック条約を緊急に締結する必要性を強調していると発言しました。

articles.title: Climber rescued after being abandoned at 2,600 metres in Austrian Alps
articles.description: Gerhard Kremser, the district manager of the Pongau Mountain Rescue Service, said the man likely would not have survived another night on the mountain due to the conditions.
articles.titleJa: オーストリアアルプスで2,600m地点に置き去りにされた登山家が救助される

The publication examines how the partnerships fostered through South-South cooperation and triangular cooperation – South-South partnerships supported by a developed economy - are helping strengthen developing economies' trade capacities and facilitate market access.
articles.titleJa: 新報告書、貿易開発における南南協力と三角協力の役割を考察
articles.summary: WTOとUNOSSCは、途上国間の貿易（南南貿易）の重要性に関する共同報告書を発表。貿易能力強化への貢献を検証した。

articles.title: Global Review 2026 spotlights partnerships for trade and development
articles.description: "Developing economies seeking trade success need stronger partnerships with all stakeholders," WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala said in her opening remarks at the 2026 Global Review on 29 October, marking 20 years of the Aid for Trade initiative. Over two days, ministers, heads of international organizations and trade and development experts will take stock of the initiative's impact, discuss evolving trade needs and explore how stronger partnerships can help developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs), turn trade opportunities into economic growth, jobs and better livelihoods.
articles.titleJa: グローバルレビュー2026、貿易と開発のためのパートナーシップに焦点
articles.summary: WTO事務局長は、途上国の貿易成功には強力なパートナーシップが必要と強調。貿易のための援助イニシアチブ20周年を記念した。

articles.title: Côte d'Ivoire President: Re-globalization an opportunity to move beyond traditional trade
articles.description: "Re-globalization presents an opportunity for developing countries to move beyond their traditional areas of specialization in exporting primary products, and to occupy a more prominent place in the spheres of innovation, transformation, industrial production and marketing." That was the key message on 29 October of H.E. Alassane Ouattara, President of Côte d'Ivoire, who delivered the latest edition of the Presidential Lecture under the WTO’s Presidential Lecture Series.
articles.titleJa: コートジボワール大統領：再グローバル化は伝統的貿易を超える機会
articles.summary: コートジボワール大統領は、再グローバル化が途上国にとって革新、生産、マーケティングで主導的な役割を担う機会だと述べた。

articles.title: WHO, WIPO and the WTO to hold 13th Joint Technical Symposium on 25 November 2026
articles.description: The World Health Organization (WHO), the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the World Trade Organization (WTO) will hold the 13th Joint Technical Symposium on Enabling Ecosystems for Local and Regional Health Products Manufacturing: Considering the Role of Trade, IP, AI and Digital Innovation on 25 November 2026, hosted by WHO at the International Conference Centre Geneva (CICG). The deadline for registration is 23 November 2026.
articles.titleJa: WHO、WIPO、WTOが第13回合同技術シンポジウムを2026年11月25日に開催
articles.summary: WHO、WIPO、WTOは、地域保健製品製造のためのエコシステム構築に関する合同シンポジウムをジュネーブで開催する。

articles.title: Members review regional trade agreements, confirm meeting frequency, adopt annual report
articles.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Regional Trade Agreements (CRTA) on 29 October, WTO members considered five regional trade agreements (RTAs) among members as well as three involving non-members. They also took note of new RTA notifications and adopted the Committee's annual report for 2026.
articles.titleJa: 加盟国、地域貿易協定をレビューし、会合頻度を確認、年次報告書を採択
articles.summary: WTO地域貿易協定委員会は、複数の地域貿易協定を審議し、新規通知に留意するとともに、2026年年次報告書を採択した。

articles.title: Trade Policy Review: Democratic Republic of the Congo
articles.description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of the Democratic Republic of the Congo takes place on 28 and 30 October 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
articles.titleJa: 貿易政策レビュー：コンゴ民主共和国
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国の貿易政策と慣行に関する第3回レビューが、WTO事務局と政府報告書に基づいて実施される。

articles.title: WTO members discuss proposals on key trade and development issues
articles.description: At meetings of the WTO's Committee on Trade and Development on 26-27 October 2026, members continued discussions on proposals covering trade as an engine for economic growth and the integration of trade and investment for industrialization. A group of members introduced a new proposal on capacity building for mutual recognition of professional qualifications. Members exchanged views and shared experiences on the three proposals.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、主要な貿易と開発に関する提案を議論
articles.summary: WTO貿易開発委員会で、経済成長と産業化のための貿易・投資統合に関する提案が議論された。専門資格の相互承認能力構築の新たな提案も行われた。
